function GitAud(soundgit,filename)
    SoundName=tostring(SoundName)
    local url=soundgit
    local FileName = filename
    writefile(FileName..".mp3", game:HttpGet(url))
    return (getcustomasset or getsynasset)(FileName..".mp3")
end
function s(soundlink, vol, filename,lop, pi)
    local cool = Instance.new("Sound")
    cool.SoundId = GitAud(soundlink, filename)
    cool.Parent = workspace
    cool.Volume = vol
    cool.Pitch= pi
    cool.Looped=lop
    cool:play()
Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect",cool).Level=9999
end
